## B2Gold Third Quarter 2026 Results – Conference Call Details


October 14, 2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF](https://s204.q4cdn.com/324791784/files/doc_news/2026/Oct/14/10-14-2026-Q3-2026-Conference-Call-Details.pdf)


VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- B2Gold Corp. (TSX: BTO, NYSE AMERICAN: BTG, NSX: B2G) (“B2Gold” or the “Company”) will release its third quarter 2026 financial and operational results after the North American markets close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.


B2Gold executives will host a conference call to discuss the results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 9:00 am PCT / 11:00 am ET. To participate in the live call, please use one of the following methods:


- Toll-free in U.S. and Canada: +1 (833) 821-2803
- International: +1 (647) 846-2419
- Webcast:[access link](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=VknLJWQ5)


The conference call will be available for playback for two weeks by dialing toll-free in the U.S. and Canada: +1 (855) 669-9658, replay access code 9332075. All other callers: +1 (412) 317-0088, replay access code 9332075.


**About B2Gold**


B2Gold is a responsible international gold producer headquartered in Vancouver, Canada. B2Gold has operating gold mines in Canada, Mali, Namibia and the Philippines, and numerous development and exploration projects in various countries.


Source: B2Gold Corp.
